title: Storybound scene
description: config/storybound/scenes/<path>.json — a cutscene: shots one after another, each a camera flight placed against an anchor (the player, an NPC, an entity, a structure, a waypoint), and what happens meanwhile. Played by the action play_scene; scene_finished fires at its end. While it plays the player is safe; set skippable to false for important scenes that cannot be skipped.

anchor.description: What the shot's points are placed against: "player", or one of npc, entity, structure, waypoint, poi. Not found near the player, in another dimension or too far: the shot is left out (unless a fallback anchor is set).

npc.description: An NPC binding: the one the mod picked, or the nearest entity it is for, within 64 blocks.

entity.description: The nearest entity this selector matches within 64 blocks.

structure.description: The structure the player stands in, else the nearest one the waypoints have found: its middle, on the ground. It faces south.

waypoint.description: Where the player sees this waypoint.

poi.description: The nearest point of interest (e.g. minecraft:meeting for a village bell) within radius blocks; faces south.

radius.description: Search radius in blocks for a poi anchor (4 to 128).

cue.description: One thing in the shot at its second: exactly one of title, caption, line, sound, music, fade, shake or actions.

at.description: Seconds from the shot's start; past its end, at its end.

title.description: Big in the middle of the screen, as a quest's title when it starts: a chapter's name.

caption.description: A place and a time ("A village by the river. Three days later.") fading in and out at its position; on black, as a silent film's title card.

position.description: Where it stands: in the lower or upper left corner, or in the middle.

black.description: On a black screen, as a title card.

duration.description: Seconds it stays; by default as long as the words take to read.

music.description: The scene's music changes to this track from here.

line.description: A line in subtitles over the lower bar.

speaker.description: Who says it: the name shown above the words.

sound.description: Its voice-over, on the Voice volume.

duration.description: Seconds it stays; by default as long as the words take to read.

fade.description: The screen fades to a colour and back, as the fade action.

shake.description: A decaying camera-shake impulse at this moment (horn blast, heavy footstep, explosion).

duration.description: How many seconds the shake decays over.

fallback.description: Optional backup anchor used if the primary anchor is not found near the player.

dialogue.description: Instead of a camera, a talk: the dialogue plays with its own camera, the anchor as the one the player talks to; the scene goes on once it is over.

camera.description: The flight: from and to are [right, up, forward] of the anchor, as it faces. Either duration or speed.

via.description: Optional intermediate points between from and to: turns the flight into a smooth 3D spline passing through each point in order.

to.description: Where the flight ends; without it the camera stays at from.

look.description: anchor: at the anchor (followed when it is an entity); path: the way the camera flies; player; free: per-point [yaw, pitch] rotations relative to the anchor; or another anchor.

rotations.description: Optional per-control-point [yaw, pitch] angles (yaw relative to the anchor, pitch -90 to 90) used when look is "free".

duration.description: Seconds the flight takes; the camera's speed follows.

speed.description: Blocks a second; the flight lasts as long as the way takes.

ease.description: How it speeds up and slows down.

fov.description: Optional camera field of view in degrees (20 to 120); without it, uses the player's own FOV.

fov_to.description: Optional ending field of view in degrees (20 to 120) for a smooth zoom-in or zoom-out across the shot.

look_offset.description: Optional [right, up, forward] shift applied to the look target for Rule of Thirds framing and headroom.

roll.description: Optional camera horizon tilt in degrees (-30 to 30, e.g. subtle Dutch tilt for tension).

roll_to.description: Optional ending camera roll in degrees (-30 to 30) to tilt smoothly across the shot.

shake.description: Optional continuous handheld breathing/drift intensity (0 to 1; 0.02 to 0.05 for subtle cinema feel).

above_ground.description: Minimum height in blocks above the highest terrain, trees, and roofs along the path (0 disables).

safe_angle.description: Automatically rotates to an open side and pulls waypoints clear of walls when the authored angle is blocked.

during.description: What happens while the shot plays.

transition.description: How the shot follows the one before: a cut, a fade through black, or a glide from where the camera was.

icon.description: Dev mode only: the item this node shows on the editor's canvases.

letterbox.description: Black bars above and below while it plays.

skippable.description: Whether the player can skip the scene with Space.

music.description: The scene's music, over every other track while it plays.

invulnerable.description: Nothing hurts the watcher but the void and /kill.

world.description: calm: mobs near do nothing to the watcher and the villagers, and no monster spawns near; live: the world goes on as usual.

on_end.description: Run when the scene has played to its end (not when a death or a teleport cut it short).
